annotation.justification: The clause provides clear guidance on the handling of duplicate Stateless Reset Tokens. It states that endpoints are not required to compare new values against all previous values, but if a duplicate is detected, it MAY be treated as a connection error. This allows for flexibility in implementation without introducing ambiguity in operational behavior.
